overview: The blue family splits across this wall, but the strongest connected line ladders straight up the right arete from the low start blobs to the top jugs. Long pulls between decent edges - set your feet before every reach.

moves.detail: Feet on the low blobs before you pull on.

moves.action: step onto the start blob's lip
reach high up the arete edge
moves.detail: Straight left arm; push through the right foot.

moves.action: bump to the crimp just above
walk your foot up the blob

moves.detail: Drive off the right foot - this is the move.

moves.action: cross to the top center jug
moves.detail: Flag the left foot to kill the swing.
